To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the proposed methodology is a viable solution for the document flow coordination problem.

(1) the proposed document distribution methodology is useful in the coordination of document flow; (2) the OK-Net is a useful tool for representing document distribution; and (3) the KA-Algebra is a useful tool to support the creation and maintenance of the OK-Net.

we have proposed a document distribution methodology that consists of two components: (1) a document world that consists of worknets and awareness nets; (2) an analytical method, KA-Algebra, to initialize and maintain the document world.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a new knowledge distribution mechanism that can be used to coordinate document flow in large organizations.
the design, analysis, and prototyping of knowledge distribution systems for large organizations.
the design of workflow-centric distribution mechanisms for organizational knowledge.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the methodology and tools developed in this paper are capable of providing a systematic approach for the analysis, design, implementation and evaluation of workflow-centric document distribution systems.
we have successfully demonstrated that the proposed document distribution methodology and its associated tools can indeed be applied to real-world problems.
we have developed a document distribution methodology that is capable of supporting the coordination of the flow of codifiable knowledge in a document world.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have developed a methodology for workflow-centric knowledge distribution.
we are able to provide an effective and systematic approach to the design, implementation, and evaluation of workflow-centric knowledge distribution systems.
we have developed a new methodology for the design and analysis of workflow-centric knowledge distribution in organizations.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the concepts of work-nets, awareness nets, and KA-algebra can be used to model and analyze the distribution of organizational knowledge.
a document-centric view of knowledge distribution is more suitable than a process-centric view.
the concepts and techniques from process-driven knowledge distribution can be applied to the domain of document flow coordination.
